A '''cautionary pulser''' was a weapon component built into the handgrip of some [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] such as the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]]. The pulser produced a silent vibrating alarm that warned the wielder when the weapon had only five shots or less left in the [[Blaster power pack/Legends|power pack]].<ref name="EGWT" />
